info.title: Chaos Admin API
info.description: Passwordless administration API for merchant accounts and headless commerce stores.

get.summary: List merchant accounts for the current user

post.summary: Create a merchant account and owner membership

get.summary: List stores in a merchant account

post.summary: Create a draft store and default currency

get.summary: Get Store configuration
List Sales Channels
Get a Sales Channel
List Store Domains without verification secrets

post.summary: Create a pending Store Domain and issue its DNS TXT challenge once

201.description: Pending Store Domain with one-time DNS challenge

post.summary: Verify a Store Domain against its DNS TXT challenge
Archive a Store Domain and stop public resolution

get.summary: List product summaries in a Store

post.summary: Create a draft product with options and variants
post.description: Creates the complete product aggregate atomically. The product remains unpublished until an explicit publication operation succeeds.

get.summary: Get a complete Product aggregate

put.summary: Publish a Product to a Sales Channel

delete.summary: Remove Product publication from a Sales Channel

get.summary: List Price Lists

post.description: Creates a Price List and its Variant prices atomically. An active list may reference only active Variants in the same Store.

put.summary: Replace Price List configuration and Variant prices

get.summary: List inventory locations
List location-specific stock balances

post.summary: Adjust on-hand inventory and append a ledger entry

get.summary: List Store API keys without secret material

post.description: The plaintext secret is returned exactly once. Replaying the Idempotency-Key returns a conflict instead of disclosing it again.

201.description: API key created; copy the one-time secret now

get.summary: List and filter Store Orders
Get an Order snapshot and transition audit trail

post.summary: Confirm an Order and consume its inventory reservation
Cancel an Order and release its inventory reservation

get.summary: List Store Payment Provider accounts without secret references

post.summary: Configure one Payment Provider for a Store
post.description: Only owners and administrators may configure providers. Secret-manager references are write-only and are never returned.

get.summary: Get a Store Payment Provider account without secret references

put.summary: Rotate secret references or enable or disable a Payment Provider account
put.description: Provider identity and external account mapping are immutable. Secret-manager references are write-only.

get.summary: List Store Tax Rules

Activate or archive a Tax Rule

get.summary: List Store Promotions
Get the effective Store Analytics Policy

put.summary: Create a new effective Store Analytics Policy version

get.summary: List configured Analytics destinations

put.summary: Create or replace one Store Analytics destination
put.description: Stores only an environment-secret reference. Credential values are never returned.

post.summary: Request deletion of Store Analytics data for one anonymous identity or Customer
post.description: Creates an asynchronous immutable audit request. Commercial Customer and Order records are not deleted.

get.summary: Get an Analytics erasure request and deletion counts
List Collections
Get a Collection with ordered products and publications

Publish an active Collection to a Sales Channel

get.summary: List bounded daily Analytics read models
get.description: Reads precomputed behavior, commerce, and attribution rows through a small read-only connection pool with database statement and lock timeouts.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, query, content type, or payload size

Forbidden.description: Authenticated caller is not allowed to access the resource

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist in the authorized scope

secret.description: One-time plaintext API key. It cannot be retrieved again.

external_destination_reference.description: Meta dataset/pixel ID or GA4 measurement ID.

event_source_base_url.description: Required HTTPS storefront base URL for Meta CAPI; omitted for GA4.

verification_record_value.description: One-time DNS TXT challenge value. It is never returned by list operations or idempotent replay.

credential_secret_reference.description: Opaque reference resolved by the deployment secret manager; never raw credentials.

webhook_secret_reference.description: Opaque reference resolved by the deployment secret manager; never a raw signing secret.

enabled.description: Requests a live Provider readiness check; effective enablement requires a ready result.

readiness_valid_until.description: End of the current readiness validity window. Enabled accounts are rechecked before this time.

credential_rotation_expires_at.description: End of the rollback window for the previous outbound credential reference, when a rotation is active.

webhook_rotation_expires_at.description: End of the verification overlap window for the previous webhook secret reference, when a rotation is active.
